description: This file is a configuration script for Vite, a build tool, specifically for a Qwik project. It defines build settings, plugin integrations, dependency management, and utility functions related to project setup.

methods.name: errorOnDuplicatesPkgDeps
methods.description: Function to identify duplicate dependencies and throw an error if any dependencies are listed both in devDependencies and dependencies, or if Qwik packages are misplaced.
